description_en: Queries the list of users under a specified instance. Supports fuzzy match by username and paging query. The list is returned in reverse chronological order by creation time
description_zh: 用于查询指定实例下的用户列表，支持按用户名模糊匹配和分页查询。列表按创建时间倒序返回
kebab_example: aliyun agentteams list-users --instance-id agentteams-test-001 --name-like demo --max-results 10 --next-token 0 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListUsers

parameters.help_en: The keyword for fuzzy match by username
parameters.help_zh: 用户名模糊匹配关键字
parameters.name: name_like

parameters.help_en: The page size. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 分页大小，默认值 10，取值范围 1 到 100
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token for the next page. A non-negative integer that represents the offset
parameters.help_zh: 下一页游标，非负整数，表示偏移量
parameters.name: next_token
